# Local glTF assets for POV dumps

Layout expected by `GltfPlayerCache` (also under `--maps-dir`):

```
players/ct_sas.glb
players/t_phoenix.glb
weapons/ak47.glb
weapons/awp.glb
weapons/deagle.glb
weapons/m4a4.glb
weapons/m4a1.glb
weapons/glock.glb
```

Export with Source 2 Viewer — see `scripts/export_cs2_assets.sh` and the
[ValveResourceFormat](https://github.com/ValveResourceFormat/ValveResourceFormat) / [s2v.app](https://s2v.app) docs.
Do not redistribute Valve assets.
